checked_properties: Exact pinned config limits and model/acquisition/relocation metadata binding without loading weights.
Native input token budget reserves output capacity and never truncates.
Response prompt/model identity, no input truncation, cold-cache counters, generated-token count and decoding settings are checked.
Eight authored completions and at most36 paired natural completions; matched question/evidence per arm.
References remain outside messages/completion body, and unrecognized reference fields are rejected.
Separate public request-state denominator survives first transport failure and prelaunch guard failure; no retries occur.
Private raw errors stay external; public records retain only error types, IDs, counts and statuses.
Raw model-file symlinks and external-output paths resolving into the repository are refused.
Successful authored qualification is tied to current reader-code recipe before natural request freeze.

development_outcomes.detail: Initial new audit module had a Python line-continuation SyntaxError; corrected before its first test execution. This was audit code, not a driver execution failure.
Added one prelaunch-memory-failure denominator control because current shared-memory pressure makes this a concrete execution risk.

initial_observations.closure: Owner pinned exact-count contract to current native server; independent fixtures reject every deficit or excess. Actual live conformity remains for the native gate.
initial_observations.observation: Initial read accepted any returned-token count <= tokens_predicted although the explanation covered only an end-token convention.

initial_observations.closure: Public request_states preserve every frozen ID; independent mocked transport failure retains one failed/seven unattempted, and prelaunch failure retains eight unattempted/zero calls.
initial_observations.observation: Initial public receipt retained only successful assessment rows plus expected total, omitting explicit failed/unattempted request IDs.

initial_observations.closure: Raw path symlink is rejected before resolving/hashing; independent mock confirms model digest is never called.
initial_observations.observation: Initial asset symlink test ran after resolving the path, making the intended guard ineffective.

initial_observations.closure: Authored gate now binds reader_recipe_sha256 and natural admission rejects a stale recipe before freeze or native launch.
initial_observations.observation: Initial natural admission checked model/config but not the current driver/interface/backend recipe.

limitations: This is authored and mocked code validation; no native server was launched and no model, tokenizer or natural QA performance was measured.
The pinned live response accounting convention, memory viability, process guard behavior and model support still require the single authorized authored gate.
The offline tests do not authenticate arbitrary researcher edits to receipts or implement a same-process security boundary.
Independent natural source/reference construction, matched information admission and full joint QA scoring remain separate gates.
